name: petflow
description: PetFlow - SaaS de gestão para pet shops

scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @petflow/api
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @petflow/api && npm run build --workspace @petflow/web && npm run build --workspace @petflow/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @petflow/worker
scripts.bootstrap:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run bootstrap:admin --workspace @petflow/api
